build_cyberark_secret_manager: build a CyberArk Conjur secret manager client that reads secrets from a password vault via HTTP API
read_secret_async_cyberark: read a secret asynchronously from CyberArk Conjur using async HTTPX client and in-memory cache
read_secret_sync_cyberark: read a secret synchronously from CyberArk Conjur using sync HTTPX client and in-memory cache
write_secret_async_cyberark: write a secret asynchronously to CyberArk Conjur by ensuring the variable exists in policy then posting the value
delete_secret_cyberark: delete a secret from CyberArk Conjur cache noting that direct deletion is not supported and requires policy updates
